projects.title: The Book
projects.lead: A narrative game where you play as an author trapped in a world of their own making.
projects.overview: The Book is a game where you play as an author trapped in a world of their making after losing a beloved family member.

showcases.heading: Diegetic Title Screen
bullets: Programmed an interaction system to allow the player to interact with the 3D book mesh

showcases.heading: Save and Load System
bullets: Implemented a loading system using the diegetic title screen
Programmed a saving system that saves the players location data

showcases.heading: Movement and Combat
bullets: Modified Unreal's Third Person Template Blueprint to include a combat system
Improved movement by adding a rolling action
Implemented animations to have seemless transitions between each other

showcases.heading: Enemy AI
bullets: Programmed an enemy behavior tree that idles and can follow the player
